patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff applies cleanly to the project checkout, and the instrumented fixed original runs clean while still reaching the second-entry guard. The fix resolves the crash by enforcing the missing per-iteration bounds check before any second-entry dereference.

nodes.description: On the crashing vulnerable path, the reused trailing-byte pointer is observed as a second entry whose `entry->GetChannelPage()` equals `OT_RADIO_CHANNEL_PAGE_0`, so execution enters the 2.4 GHz branch.
Immediately before the inline `ChannelMaskEntry::GetMask()` sink, the 4-byte mask read selected by the page-0 branch extends past the copied TLV end.
nodes.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `mask_read.mask_read_end_ptr > mask_read.tlv_end_ptr`.

edges.description: The non-null pointer returned by `GetNext(this)` is reused unchanged as the next-loop `entry` value at the missing guard site.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `next_entry_return.entry_ptr == second_entry_guard.entry_ptr`.

edges.description: The same reused second-entry pointer that arrives at the missing guard site is the pointer whose channel page is tested in the page-0 branch.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `second_entry_guard.entry_ptr == second_entry_branch.entry_ptr`.

edges.description: The same page-0-selected entry pointer is passed through unchanged to the immediate `GetMask()` call that triggers the inline sink.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `second_entry_branch.entry_ptr == mask_read.entry_ptr`.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before any non-first `entry` is dereferenced as a `ChannelMaskEntry`, the full fixed-size object must still fit inside the copied Channel Mask TLV (`(entry + 1) <= reinterpret_cast<const ChannelMaskEntry *>(GetValue() + GetLength())`).
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original case violates this predicate and still reaches `second_entry_branch`, while the fixed original is guarded before the branch. The nearest valid boundary mutation (`second_entry_exact_fit_page0`) stayed clean on both versions but exercised no assertion event at all, because once the Channel Mask TLV length is increased enough to try to hold a real second entry, this `GetChannelMask(const Message&)` path no longer materializes the 8-byte stack-local `channelMaskTlv` object that underlies the frozen second-entry-specific obligation.
